values.note: RV electric sites $35 a night in peak season (about May 7 - Sep 14 in 2026), $28 off-peak; a lower RV-electric rate of $30/$26 also appears in the table. The 'standard non-electric' sites ($25/$23) are catalogued for tents only, as are the tent-only sites; group tent area $50. Same rates 2025-2028.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272174/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-07 to 2026-09-14: RV ELECTRIC $35, STANDARD NONELECTRIC $25; Non-Peak 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-06: RV ELECTRIC $28) + catalog (every STANDARD NONELECTRIC site's equipment is TENT only), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 272174 (16 RV ELECTRIC sites: 6 list 50-amp, 10 list 30-amp; 10 list a water hookup; no sewer hookup attribute) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272174 ('a variety of sites available from full RV hookup to primitive tent camp sites'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov lists 16 RV electric sites, 15 standard non-electric and 11 tent-only sites (the non-electric ones catalogued for tents), a group tent area and 2 management sites. Driveways 34-62 ft on the RV sites, 4 of them pull-through; only sites 021-023 carry a max vehicle length (22 ft).

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 272174 (site types, Driveway Length, Driveway Entry, Max Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272174 ('Patrons at the campground will have access to flushing toilets, drinking water, showers and a dump station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov rule: 14 nights in any rolling 30 days ('Camping ... longer than 14 days during any 30-consecutive-day period is prohibited without the written permission of the District Commander'). The campground and boat launch can close for high water.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/272174 (facility_rules maxStay 14 nights per rolling 30 days; notices), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric with water, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed fees low 25 -> 28 (the $25 'standard non-electric' sites are catalogued tent-only, so the RV base is the $28 off-peak / $35 peak RV-electric rate). Added 42 sites with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, 14-night max. Not stated: sewer (the description's 'full RV hookup' is not borne out by any sewer attribute, so left unknown), campground season (rate seasons only), booking window; rec.gov's 'militaryDiscount' rule has no wording, not recorded.
